preconditions.description: The length of the passage P is between 1 and 1,000,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#.' for c in P)
preconditions.description: The characters in the passage P are either '#' or '.'.
The first and last characters of P are '#', indicating the start and end of the passage.
The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= days_to_cross(P) <= 1000000 for P in P_list)
postconditions.description: For each passage P, the number of days it takes Digory and Polly to cross the passage is between 1 and 1,000,000.
